name: Omokage Railback
source:
During Masashi’s last summer as a student, it was decided that he would transfer schools due to his non-blood-related older sister Juri’s work as the young manager of Yoshioka Construction. His new school would be in the small rural town of Yagurana, located at the end of the railroad. He met the young land-owner Iroha, who vows to protect the land from corporations, and started going to school with her. However, the reason why he was there was because of Yoshioka Construction’s desire to develop the land. Moreover, he was the heir of the corporation itself.

[From [url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2016/02/06/february-2016-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
translation:
雅志学生时代的最后一个夏天，由于没有血缘关系的姐姐朱莉担任吉冈建设的年轻经理，他被安排转学。新学校位于铁路尽头的小乡镇矢仓奈。雅志在那里遇见年轻的土地所有者伊吕波；她发誓要保护土地，不让企业开发，并与雅志一起上学。然而，雅志之所以来到这里，正是因为吉冈建设想开发这片土地。更糟的是，他本人还是这家公司的继承人。

[来源：[url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2016/02/06/february-2016-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
